name: Eye Rest
description: A short screen break for your eyes: look far, blink slowly, look near and far again.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A five-step screen break for your eyes, on Guided Pause.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Use as many steps as you like.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Do what each step says. It moves on by itself.
Press Next to skip a step or Back to repeat one.
tips: This is a break, not advice. Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip any step.
